نلتقي (form VIII)
# نَلْتَقِي (naltaqī) /nal.ta.qiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
# نَلْتَقِيَ (naltaqiya) /nal.ta.qi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
